episodeTitle.en: When enough is enough | Andy Johns (ex-FB, Twitter, Quora)
episodeTitle.zh: 当适可而止时 | 安迪·约翰斯（前Facebook、Twitter、Quora员工）

guestBioOfficial.en: Andy Johns is a former tech exec and VC who had a successful run at several startups—including Facebook, Twitter, Wealthfront, and Quora—but left it all behind a few years ago to take a new direction in life. Now a mental health advocate, he aids military veterans with PTSD, guides burnt-out high achievers to new paths, and shares his healing journey from childhood trauma and mental illness through his newsletter, Clues Dot Life. In this episode, we discuss: • Why Andy left his seven-figure VC career behind
guestBioOfficial.zh: 安迪·约翰斯曾是科技高管和风险投资人，曾在Facebook、Twitter、Wealthfront和Quora等多家初创公司成功任职，但几年前他放下一切，转向了新的人生方向。如今，作为心理健康倡导者，他帮助患有创伤后应激障碍的退伍军人，引导精疲力竭的成功人士走上新道路，并通过他的新闻通讯《Clues Dot Life》分享自己从童年创伤和心理疾病中康复的治愈之旅。在本期节目中，我们讨论了：• 安迪为何放弃七位数的风险投资事业

title.en: When enough is enough | Andy Johns (ex-FB, Twitter, Quora)
title.zh: 当适可而止时 | 安迪·约翰斯（前Facebook、Twitter、Quora员工）

summary.en: Andy shares his personal story of burnout and transformation, explaining the physical and behavioral signals—sleep, relationships, health—that act as flashing red alarms for wellbeing. He lays out a four-step process for making lasting change and how to actually allow that change to happen in your life. The conversation is a candid, real-talk episode on mental health, burnout, and reclaiming your path in and beyond tech.
summary.zh: Andy 分享了自己倦怠与转变的个人故事，讲解了睡眠、人际关系、健康等作为身心健康“红色警报”的生理与行为信号。他给出了实现持久改变的四步法，以及如何真正让改变在自己身上发生。这期对话坦诚直白，聚焦心理健康、倦怠，以及在科技行业内外重新找回人生方向。
